sentences.en: I think your father hoped you would go to college.
sentences.zh: 我认为你父亲希望你能上大学。

sentences.en: While employed at the bank, he taught economics at college.
sentences.zh: 在银行工作的时候，他还在学院里教经济学。

sentences.en: Some college teachers come to class late and leave early.
sentences.zh: 有些大学老师上课迟到早退。

senses.zh: 大学; 学院; 职业学校, 技术专科学校; 学会; 社团; 学院的全体师生
